title: The Boy Who Planted Trees
topic: เรื่องเล่า
lines: When Arun was twelve, a flood destroyed the rice fields around his
village. The old people said the hills had once been covered with trees,
which held the rain like a sponge. Now **they** were bare, and the water
rushed straight down into the valley.
Arun decided to do something. Every evening after school, he climbed
the nearest hill with a bag of seeds and a small knife. His friends
laughed at **him**. "One boy cannot change a mountain," they said. But Arun
did not stop. He planted ten seeds a day, every day, for eight years.
By the time he finished university, the hill was green again. When the
next big rain came, the fields stayed dry. **Those** who had laughed now
asked him for seeds. Today, the whole village plants trees each June,
and children learn **his** story at school. Arun says the hardest part was
not the climbing. "It was believing that small things matter," he says.
